items.title: Acquire a shared workspace validation capacity lease before story validation
items.context: Existing validationExecutionLockPath is story-scoped, so B-a7c5 and B-9ff1 validations ran concurrently for 20-30 minutes and caused unrelated canonical members to hit 120/180/300-second limits. Add a worktree-independent capacity mutex keyed by git common dir while preserving the per-story evidence lock and fixed lock ordering.

items.title: Prove cross-story contention, stale recovery, reentrancy, and release behavior
items.context: Use two different story IDs/worktree roots to prove the second validation cannot execute while the first live lease is held; verify holder diagnostics, heartbeat freshness, stale dead-owner reclaim, nested same-context reentrancy, release after success/throw/signal where applicable, and that no validation command callback starts on contention.

items.title: Prove official validation gates retain their existing commands and budgets
items.context: Both validate and done_required_validate must consume the shared capacity lease without changing configured command inventories, per-command timeouts, root full-suite 120/300-second proof thresholds, evidence bindings, or direct read-only commands.
